text:
maria: PR up for a unified rotation operator that supports air-gapped USB manifests and HSM/KMS-backed auto-accept. RFC: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/438

sam: important constraint: operator MUST never persist private keys for airgap. can we prove zero key exposure?

igor: model: operator only verifies detached signatures and passes signed delegation tokens to node verifiers. offline signer signs rotation bundle; operator stores signer_pub, token_id, and expiry only.

lucy: rollout concern: partial apply across a fleet. propose explicit overlap window + staged state machine so older nodes keep accepting old signer during overlap.

maria: agree. draft state machine: PRE-ROTATE -> OVERLAP (both accepted) -> CUTOVER. Overlap length configurable via manifest.overlap_seconds.

ton y: for airgap, admin flow should be simple: create rotation.tar.gz + rotation.sig on an offline machine, copy to USB, run `redwoodctl rotation apply --file /media/rotation.tar.gz --mode offline`. operator validates checksum/signature then enters CANARY if requested.

sam: add fail-safes: if CANARY fails, operator should abort and not proceed to CUTOVER. also ensure GC of old signer only after `gc_retention_seconds` post-finalize.

igor: add compatibility shim: older operators (<v2.3) treat rotation manifests as immediate dual-accept for 30 days to allow rolling updates. include migration tests.

lucy: tests: simulate node reboot mid-overlap, simulate USB corruption (bad checksum), simulate clock skew where node time <- operator time. operator must validate token nonces and not rely solely on wall clock for safety.

maria: telemetry events: rotation_started, rotation_overlap_entered, rotation_cutover_attempted, rotation_cutover_failed, rotation_finalized, rotation_rolled_back. will add to RFC and console dashboard traces.

ton y: UX: add `--dry-run` mode to CLI to validate signature, compute eligible canary set and report which nodes would flip. also provide `--force` to bypass canary for advanced users.

sam: audit: ensure audit logs include signer_id, manifest_sha256, phase, admin_user, and operator_version. needed for compliance audits.

igor: security: operator should validate attestation chain if present (tpm/uefi). optional but recommended. include manifest format example in RFC.

maria: thanks all. I'll update PR with state machine, CLI examples, compatibility shim, e2e chaos tests, telemetry and audit fields. tagging @sam @igor for final review.
